class.name: GlobalTransmit
class.brief_description: Sends transmissions on channels to anything that listens, without sender and receiver knowing of each other.

method.name: clear_channel
method.description: Removes every listener of [param channel] and forgets its last arguments and transmission count.

method.name: get_arguments
method.description: Returns the arguments of the last transmission on [param channel], or an empty [Array] if nothing was transmitted on it yet. Useful for a receiver that starts listening after the transmission, such as a node entering the scene later.

method.name: get_channels
method.description: Returns every channel that has listeners or was transmitted on, names and numbers.

method.name: get_transmission_count
method.description: Returns how many transmissions went out on [param channel] since it was last cleared.

method.name: is_listening
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param callable] listens on [param channel].

method.name: listen
method.description: Calls [param callable] with the arguments of every transmission on [param channel], a name or a number. Listening twice with the same callable on the same channel has no further effect.

method.name: stop_listening
method.description: Stops [param callable] from receiving transmissions on [param channel].

method.name: transmit
method.description: Sends a transmission on [param channel], a name or a number, with the rest of the arguments, and calls every listener of the channel with them at once. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if the channel is neither a name nor a number.

method.name: transmit_array
method.description: Like [method transmit], with the arguments given as an [Array].

method.name: transmit_deferred
method.description: Like [method transmit], but the listeners are called at the end of the current frame.

signal.name: transmitted
signal.description: Emitted after every transmission, on any channel, once its listeners were called. Useful to log or debug transmissions.
